title: Door / Wall / Gap
summary: Makes legitimate routes, binding blockers, and unresolved uncertainty distinct decision states.
mechanism: A Door is a sufficiently safe route forward; a Wall blocks the proposed form; a Gap records missing evidence or a route through which harm can escape. A Gap cannot be upgraded by urgency or confidence alone.
test_status: The classification contract is specified; calibration and cross-rater reliability remain open.
next_tests: Create boundary cases between Gap and Wall
Test whether new evidence moves states in the intended direction
